source_refs.note: Exercise 3.3, Question 13: book p. 89-90, 24 questions (integration by parts); answer key p. 301 (printed under 'Exercise 3.5')

blocks.explanation:
Denominator \(1 - \sin x\) ko hatane ki chaal: upar neeche \(1 + \sin x\) se zarb karein, kyunke \((1 - \sin x)(1 + \sin x) = 1 - \sin^2 x = \cos^2 x\).
Phir integrand \(x(\sec^2 x + \sec x\tan x)\) ban jata hai.
Bracket ka integral \(\tan x + \sec x\) hai, is liye \(x\) first aur bracket second function.
Plan: rationalise, parts, phir \(\int \tan x\) aur \(\int \sec x\) ke standard results.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \frac{x}{1 - \sin x}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: upar neeche \(1 + \sin x\) se zarb; phir parts, \(x\) first aur \(\sec^2 x + \sec x\tan x\) second.

Denominator saaf karein
\[\dfrac{x}{1 - \sin x}\cdot\dfrac{1 + \sin x}{1 + \sin x} = \dfrac{x(1 + \sin x)}{\cos^2 x}\]
\[= x(\sec^2 x + \sec x\tan x)\]
Kyun: \((a - b)(a + b) = a^2 - b^2\) se neeche \(1 - \sin^2 x = \cos^2 x\). Phir \(\frac{1}{\cos^2 x} = \sec^2 x\) aur \(\frac{\sin x}{\cos^2 x} = \frac{1}{\cos x}\cdot\frac{\sin x}{\cos x} = \sec x\tan x\).

Parts lagayein
\[\int (\sec^2 x + \sec x\tan x)\,dx = \tan x + \sec x\]
\[= x(\tan x + \sec x) - \int (\tan x + \sec x)\,dx\]
Kyun: \(\tan x\) ka derivative \(\sec^2 x\) aur \(\sec x\) ka derivative \(\sec x\tan x\); is liye bracket ka integral \(\tan x + \sec x\). \(x\) ka derivative 1.

Standard integrals
\[= x\tan x + x\sec x - \ln|\sec x|\]
\[\quad - \ln|\sec x + \tan x| + c\]
Kyun: \(\int \tan x\,dx = \ln|\sec x|\) aur \(\int \sec x\,dx = \ln|\sec x + \tan x|\), dono minus ke saath.
Dhyan dein: \(\int \sec x\,dx\) ko \(\sec x\tan x\) ya \(\tan x\) likh dena aam ghalti hai; yeh log wala result hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}[x(\tan x + \sec x)] = \tan x + \sec x + x(\sec^2 x + \sec x\tan x)\]
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}[\ln|\sec x| + \ln|\sec x + \tan x|] = \tan x + \sec x\]
Kyun: pehle mein se doosra minus karein to \(\tan x + \sec x\) cancel ho kar \(x(\sec^2 x + \sec x\tan x)\) bachta hai, jo step 1 ke mutabiq \(\frac{x}{1 - \sin x}\) hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(x\tan x + x\sec x - \ln|\sec x| - \ln|\sec x + \tan x| + c\)
